issue_context.title: $$ Math Markup inside tables is not supported
issue_context.body:
### Description

Github supports both single `$` and double `$$` for math blocks inside table cells, and Gitea documents `ENABLE_MATH` to support both as well. But it appears that `$$` is only supported *outside* tables, and the `pytablewriter` python module generates `$$` markup for color markup in tables.

| x     | y    |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| $2^4$ | $$2^4$$  |

See https://demo.gitea.com/microtherion/Markup/issues/1 for a demonstration.

### Gitea Version

1.22.0

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

Yes

### Log Gist

_No response_

### Screenshots

_No response_

### Git Version

2.45.1

### Operating System

Linux

### How are you running Gitea?

Using official docker image.

### Database

SQLite

review_comments: What happens to `$$ a $$ xxxxxxxxx $$ b $$`?

> What happens to `$$ a $$ xxxxxxxxx $$ b $$`?

In the current version, any text after a $$ block will be ignored because it is rendered as a block. So, I check the character after the second $$; if any text exists, it will not be rendered as a block.

In the current version, only `a` will be displayed ,  `xxxxxxx` and `b` will disappear.
After the fix,  `a`  , `xxxxxxx`, and `b` will all be displayed.
